blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Traffic flow along six roads in Barangay Rosario, Pasig City, will be affected starting 5 p.m. on Wednesday, Oct. 7, as the city holds its Araw ng Barangay Rosario procession, according to a traffic advisory from the Pasig City Public Information Office. The affected roads are Dr. Sixto Antonio Avenue, Bernal Street, Doña Juana Subdivision, C. Raymundo Avenue, Westbank Road, and Ortigas Avenue. In its advisory posted online Monday, the city government said the traffic adjustments would begin at 5 p.m. and continue “onwards” on Oct. 7.
